purpose: Determine whether the preregistered V2.8.3 minimum information requirements are satisfied without exposing factor-return association or any interim performance statistic.

valid_date_definition.market_state: CALM or STRESSED from the frozen D-vintage signal feature receipt
valid_date_definition.eligible_rows: rows where the hypothesis factor is finite in the frozen D-vintage feature CSV and D+10 fwd_return is finite in the frozen same-T-vintage outcome CSV

allowed_outputs: valid CALM date count per hypothesis
valid STRESSED date count per hypothesis
valid CALM date count by calendar quarter per hypothesis
count of dates structurally invalid because fewer than 50 eligible rows
forbidden_outputs: Rank-IC or any correlation/covariance between factor and return
mean/median forward return conditioned on factor
any PASS/FAIL of H1 or H2 before readiness

decision.READY_FOR_LOCKED_CONFIRMATORY_EVALUATION: Every hypothesis independently satisfies all minimum information requirements.
decision.INCOMPLETE_NO_EVALUATION: At least one hypothesis lacks minimum information; confirmatory evaluator must not run.
